_comment: Single source of truth for host SSH targets, IPs, WireGuard peer identities, and per-host desktop/config-file facts. Read by the host-touching skills (ssh-host, journal, remote-rebuild, nix-repl, fleet-status, fleet-rollout, vpn-status, verify-service) AND the package/DE skills (add-package, add-flatpak, switch-de, new-module) instead of each re-typing a copy. Desktop hosts (HM, Flatpak, swappable DE) have `desktop: true`; `envFile` is the host's system-config file. Update HERE only.

vpn-server.notes: Oracle Cloud ARM VM, public-facing. bosko has passwordless sudo; the Oracle ubuntu cloud-init user no longer accepts the key.

pi-hole.notes: DNS appliance (the nameserver) at 10.0.0.20; NOT a flake host. bosko@ SSH is currently denied (different auth) — shortcut kept for reference.
